posts.title: The Best-Connected Actor
posts.description: I like good data journalism, and The Pudding has once again delivered a fine – and slightly nerdy – piece of it: they set out to find the best-connected actor in Hollywood. Their starting point is Six Degrees of Kevin Bacon , a game based on the concept of six degrees of separation , which posits that any two people on Earth are six or fewer acquaintance links apart. posts.title: How War Is Waged Today
posts.description: Ukraine has become the testing ground for how wars will be fought in the future, and Reuters shows what that looks like on the ground. Its scrolling reconstruction " Inside Ukraine's Kill Zone " takes you from the sky down into the trenches along a band up to about 20 miles wide around the front line, where drones hunt anything that moves.
